solusi_description: PT Wasteforchange Alam Indonesia is a holistic waste management service provider based in Bekasi, Indonesia. As a company, we are aiming to become a leader in providing ethical and responsible waste management solutions while reducing the amount of waste disposed in landfills by cultivating circular economic initiatives.
layanan: We provide end-to-end solutions for your waste management needs through our four core services:
consult: meeting your waste management information needs through research and consultation services tailored for you
campaign: helping you spread the message of responsible waste management practices through training and public relations campaigns
collect: helping you manage waste responsibly through collection and processing
create: supporting you in reducing environmental impacts related to waste by extending the lifecycle of your waste through circular economy initiatives
